Alter Cycles Tuesday Mountain Bike Ride

Bozeman, MT · Northeast · Mountain bike

Alter Cycles Tuesday Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Bozeman, MT. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Alter Cycles. Pace: social, intermediate to advanced.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.

Look at @alter_bozeman the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Alter Cycles Tuesday Mountain Bike Ride group ride

Meet at the shop at 6, carpool to a different trail each week, ride, then grill at the trailhead while the sun goes down. Aimed at the average trail-bike rider; pace is intermediate to advanced. Bring your own food for the BBQ. Weather dependent; the week's trail is posted on the shop's Instagram or you can call the shop that day.
